statement.notes: The schema requested only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. This value was directly available as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for each year. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide a further breakdown of the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure itself. Therefore, the array contains one element per period, mapping directly from the primary statement.
